en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-346 Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Yusuf al-Baghdadi narrated that Ali ibn Muhammad ibn 'Anbasa quoted on the authority of Darim ibn Qabeesa that Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.) quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers, on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) that the Messenger of Allah (sw) said, “
Seek goodness in the company of those with pleasant faces, for indeed their actions are more likely to be good.”
